product_overview: ChatSphere is a secure, privacy-first communication platform for real-time messaging and collaboration. It uses mobile OTP registration, username-based identity, and encrypted backend support to deliver a responsive web chat experience.
core_goals: Enable secure registration and login through mobile number, OTP, and username credentials
Provide authenticated user profile management and user discovery
Support chat creation, retrieval, and message access for real-time communication
Preserve user privacy by hiding phone numbers and relying on username identity
Deliver a backend foundation for encrypted, scalable messaging workflows

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, and request OTP verification using mobile number and username-based credentials.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid mobile number, username, and password -> Receive 201 confirmation for new user registration -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/send-otp with a valid mobile number -> Receive 200 confirming OTP delivery -> POST /api/auth/register with invalid or missing registration data -> Receive 400 with validation error

POST /api/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/auth/send-otp with an unrecognized mobile number -> Receive 404 or 400 error indicating OTP could not be sent

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Lets authenticated users retrieve, update, and search user profiles while maintaining hidden phone number privacy.
user_flows: GET /api/users/profile with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with the authenticated user's profile -> PUT /api/users/profile with updated profile fields -> Receive 200 confirming profile update
GET /api/users/profile without an auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> PUT /api/users/profile with invalid profile data -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/users/search with a valid JWT token and search query -> Receive 200 with matching users -> GET /api/users/search with missing or empty query -> Receive 400 error response

features.name: Chat Management
features.description: Supports viewing chats, creating new chats, and fetching messages for authenticated users.
user_flows: POST /api/chats with a valid JWT token and recipient or participant data -> Receive 201 with created chat details -> GET /api/chats with the same token -> Receive 200 with list of chats -> GET /api/chats/:id/messages for the created chat -> Receive 200 with message history
GET /api/chats without an auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/chats with invalid participant identifiers -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/chats/:id/messages with a valid token but non-existent chat id -> Receive 404 not found response -> GET /api/chats with a valid token -> Receive 200 with available chats
